_schema_guide.description: Dynamically Defined Local Identifier (DDLI) Train Composition Schema Guide

keys.name: Descriptive human-readable name string (e.g., 'Engine_Core_Metrics', 'Transmission_Metrics').
keys.transmission_mode: ISO 14230-3 transmission mode options: 'fast' (0x04 periodic broadcast), 'medium' (0x03), 'slow' (0x02), 'single' (0x01 active polling on demand), 'stop' (0x00 stop transmission).
keys.dids: Array of DID string keys referenced in sequence order from master dids.json (e.g., ['RPM', 'HPFP_Pressure', 'Oil_Temp']).
